title: Compliant is the New Disruptive: A Venture Backed Health Playbook
subtitle: How to make money in healthcare
text:
We have seen the disaster of venture-backed health technology companies. They thought they could ignore the standards. I have personally benefited from writing about these things because people want to read them.

Investors love a story about disrupting industries. Unfortunately, in Healthcare, the most destructive thing you could possibly do is not break the rules; it's actually following them to the letter.

Photo by engin akyurt on Unsplash

Fax machines are still used in healthcare not because they're a disruptive technology. Communication over phone lines is legally exempted from additional regulations related to HIPAA. Pagers are the same thing. It works because it's compliant, so these legacy technologies stay around like a cockroach after nuclear Armageddon.

Healthcare should benefit patients. It should benefit physicians. It should benefit nurses. And it should benefit balance sheets. The way to align all of those incentives is to get behind the technology is that tied together better outcomes, existing standards, and profitability. Fax machines do that to this day.

I have proposed health technology companies before, and I will propose more now:

(to be clear, this is pure clickbait, and there is nothing of value behind this paywall. Only satire. Zero serious or actual value. Do not pay to subscribe and get angry there is nothing useful; you were warned).

• Calendly. It is really good. It is not compliant with HIPAA.1

Somebody, anybody, buy that company. And then offer a business associate agreement. Comply with HIPAA. Boom, you have a patient self-scheduling tool! Hospitals will pay a bazillion dollars for that.

• Zapier…but for healthcare. They also won't sign a business associate agreement. This means it is also not able to be used in healthcare.

Please buy Zapier. Somebody. Anybody. Sell the same product, but allow a business associate agreement to be signed.

Now you can automate the internal workings of a healthcare business! Amazing. Billions.

Overnight success!

iPhone…but for healthcare. I can make your iPhone HIPAA compliant immediately…watch this…turn off iMessage. That is my IP.

Suddenly all of your text messages by SMS…are compliant with HIPAA.

In fairness, this is not the best solution; you should use Spruce Health, which allows you to do the same thing but better. Here is a whole talk about how great it is.

I am a doctor. I want to live in the future. Möbius MD is awesome, and transcribes things like dragon used to. That is already compliant. Use that, because it is a “keyboard.”

More gems!

Pagers…with AI.

Fax machines…with AI.

I'm done.

For now.

Share The Frontier Psychiatrists

1Integrated with EPIC? Suddenly, you now have the ability to comply with all sorts of standards, everybody makes more money, and nobody has to have the endless hassle of being a Doctor who can't send a patient a Calendly invite to do self-scheduling.
